Falsifying observation: if near-52w-high stocks with deep pullbacks show equal stop-risk, the compression signal is spurious.
proposals.name: near_high_shallow_pullback

proposal.hypothesis: High-volume entries with shallow pullbacks indicate institutional absorption of supply, reducing stop-risk. The minimum of pullback depth and volume ratio isolates entries where both conditions hold: tight consolidation AND above-average volume. Falsifying observation: if high-volume entries with shallow pullbacks show equal or worse stop-risk than shallow-pullback entries with low volume, volume does not add discriminative power to pullback depth alone.
proposal.name: shallow_pullback_absorbing_volume

proposal.hypothesis: Overhead resistance with lagging earnings grounds price extension in weak fundamentals, increasing vulnerability to stop-outs. The product amplifies ceiling proximity when EPS growth is weak (low train_percentile), capturing structurally extended positions without fundamental support. Falsifying observation: if near-ceiling stocks with strong EPS growth show equal stop-risk as weak-EPS near-ceiling stocks, fundamental grounding provides no protective effect against overhead supply.
proposal.name: extended_without_earnings_support

proposals.hypothesis: High-volume entries with shallow pullbacks indicate institutional absorption of supply, reducing stop-risk. The minimum of pullback depth and volume ratio isolates entries where both conditions hold: tight consolidation AND above-average volume. Falsifying observation: if high-volume entries with shallow pullbacks show equal or worse stop-risk than shallow-pullback entries with low volume, volume does not add discriminative power to pullback depth alone.
proposals.name: shallow_pullback_absorbing_volume

proposals.hypothesis: Overhead resistance with lagging earnings grounds price extension in weak fundamentals, increasing vulnerability to stop-outs. The product amplifies ceiling proximity when EPS growth is weak (low train_percentile), capturing structurally extended positions without fundamental support. Falsifying observation: if near-ceiling stocks with strong EPS growth show equal stop-risk as weak-EPS near-ceiling stocks, fundamental grounding provides no protective effect against overhead supply.
proposals.name: extended_without_earnings_support

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks near overhead resistance that have experienced multiple pullback cycles exhibit distribution fatigue, increasing stop-risk on subsequent entries. The minimum of ceiling proximity and pullback count captures structurally extended positions with demonstrated weakness history. Falsifying observation: if near-ceiling stocks with zero or few pullbacks show equal stop-risk as near-ceiling stocks with multiple pullbacks, historical pullback frequency does not predict structural vulnerability.
proposals.name: extended_ceiling_with_distribution_history

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks repeatedly touching EMA10 as resistance combined with multiple pullback cycles exhibit structural distribution fatigue. The minimum of pullback_count and touched_ema10_count captures stocks where both measures are elevated, indicating repeated institutional selling pressure at moving averages. Falsifying observation: if high pullback-count stocks without EMA10 touches show equal stop-risk to stocks with both signals, the EMA10 interaction provides no additional explanatory power beyond pullback count alone.
proposals.name: pullback_with_ema10_distribution

proposals.hypothesis: Deep bases with extended consolidation periods represent compressed energy builds; the combination of deep pullback and long duration (minimum) identifies the most developed bases where supply has been fully absorbed. Extremely shallow or short bases lack this absorption quality. Falsifying observation: if deep-but-short or shallow-but-long bases show equal stop-risk, base development requires both dimensions simultaneously.
proposals.name: deep_long_base_absorption

proposals.hypothesis: Dry pullbacks (low volume) combined with moderate percentage declines signal distribution without absorption—weak institutions exiting without new accumulation. This interaction isolates low-volume selling pressure rather than institutional rotation. Falsifying observation: if dry pullbacks with shallow percentage declines show equal or better stop-risk than wet pullbacks with similar depth, volume regime during pullbacks has no structural implication.
proposals.name: dry_shallow_pullback_risk

proposals.hypothesis: Multi-box bases with accompanying volume confirm genuine institutional accumulation rather than quiet distribution periods. The interaction of base_mbox_count with volume_ratio captures stocks where repeated base formation coincides with volume confirmation. Falsifying observation: if multi-box bases without volume confirmation show equal or better stop-risk than those with volume, base formation alone lacks accumulation signal.
proposals.name: base_mbox_volume_accumulation

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks significantly lagging their IBD candidate peers carry sector rotation or negative sentiment risk that increases stop-vulnerability. Low current_vs_ibd_candidate_pct captures relative weakness versus the IBD candidate pool, indicating structural underperformance. Falsifying observation: if IBD-lagging stocks show equal stop-risk as IBD-leading stocks, relative strength positioning provides no structural signal.
proposals.name: relative_ibd_underperformance

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks forming tight bases (low base_depth_pct) that respect EMA10 without repeated touches, combined with volume confirmation, represent clean accumulation structures with low distribution pressure. The minimum captures stocks where both base compression and EMA10 respect are present. Falsifying observation: if tight bases with repeated EMA10 violations show equal stop-risk as tight bases with EMA10 respect, structural cleanliness provides no protective effect.
proposals.name: tight_base_ema10_respect

proposals.hypothesis: When the pullback is dry (volume not expanding) and current volume is relatively low compared to its historical distribution, the stock is less likely to experience sharp stop-loss cascades. Falsifying observation: if the stop-loss capture advantage disappears when volume ratio is high despite a dry pullback, the mechanism fails.
proposals.name: dry_pullback_low_vol_min

proposals.hypothesis: A deep base (large magnitude negative depth) combined with low relative volume signals accumulation before a breakout, reducing stop-loss risk. Falsifying observation: if deep bases with high volume produce similar stop risk, the interaction is not causal.
proposals.name: deep_base_low_vol_product

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks with low earnings growth and a tight IBD breakout range are less prone to sharp reversals; the difference captures a combined safety margin. Falsifying observation: if low EPS growth combined with a wide breakout range still yields the same stop risk advantage, the hypothesis is false.
proposals.name: low_eps_low_breakout_diff

proposals.hypothesis: A dry pullback (volume not expanding) combined with low current volume signals distribution without accumulation, reducing stop-loss cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if dry pullbacks still exhibit elevated stop-loss capture when current volume is high, the volume-dryness mechanism does not causally reduce risk.
proposals.name: dry_pullback_x_low_vol

proposals.hypothesis: Weak earnings growth combined with a tight IBD breakout range indicates institutional hesitation and a sound structural base, lowering stop-loss volatility. Falsifying observation: if weak EPS growth with wide breakout ranges still produces the same favorable stop-risk profile, the interaction is spurious.
proposals.name: weak_eps_tight_breakout_product

proposals.hypothesis: Large absolute depth or long duration alone signals a mature base; their maximum captures the dominant accumulation dimension. Deep, prolonged bases are prone to sharp stop cascades when volume eventually expands. Falsifying observation: if bases with neither deep depth nor long duration produce equivalent stop risk upon volume expansion, the structural interpretation fails.
proposals.name: deep_or_long_base_max

proposals.hypothesis: When the pullback is dry (volume not expanding) and the IBD breakout range is tight relative to its historical distribution, the stock experiences less volatile price action and lower stop-loss cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if dry pullbacks combined with a wide breakout range still produce the same stop-risk advantage, the interaction fails.
proposals.name: dry_pullback_tight_breakout_min

proposals.hypothesis: Weak earnings growth combined with a deep base (large negative depth) signals accumulation without overextension, reducing the likelihood of sharp stop-loss reversals. Falsifying observation: if low EPS growth with a shallow base yields equivalent stop risk, the structural interaction is spurious.
proposals.name: low_eps_deep_base_min

proposals.hypothesis: Low relative volume combined with a tight IBD breakout range indicates limited supply and low volatility, lowering stop-loss cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if low volume with a wide breakout range still produces the same risk reduction, the hypothesis fails.
proposals.name: low_vol_tight_breakout_min

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks near their 52-week peak experiencing minimal pullback signal institutional holding with limited distribution, reducing stop-loss cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if low pullback percentage with near-52w-high positioning still produces elevated stop-loss capture, the institutional-support mechanism fails.
proposals.name: near_peak_tight_pullback_min

proposals.hypothesis: Weak EPS growth combined with near-52w-high positioning captures institutional hesitation near the peak; the low pullback from peak suggests absorption without distribution, lowering stop-loss volatility. Falsifying observation: if high EPS growth stocks near their 52-week high exhibit equal or better stop-risk profiles, the earnings-hesitation component is spurious.
proposals.name: weak_eps_near_peak_min

proposals.hypothesis: Tight pullback combined with low relative volume indicates limited supply and low volatility, reducing cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if tight pullbacks with high relative volume still produce equivalent risk reduction, the volume-constrained mechanism does not hold.
proposals.name: tight_pullback_low_vol_min

proposals.hypothesis: Short base duration combined with low relative volume captures rapid, compressed accumulation without extended distribution. Stocks that form tight bases quickly with subdued volume are less prone to sharp stop-loss cascades because institutional activity is contained. Falsifying observation: if short-duration bases still exhibit elevated stop-loss capture regardless of volume regime, the duration-volume interaction does not constrain cascade risk.
proposals.name: short_base_low_vol_min

proposals.hypothesis: Stocks that repeatedly touch the EMA 10 (multiple micro-pullbacks) while volume stays low signal institutional absorption at a technical level without distribution pressure. The combination of structural testing and volume restraint reduces stop-loss cascade probability. Falsifying observation: if stocks with frequent EMA 10 touches still experience sharp stop-loss cascades when volume is low, the technical-boundary mechanism fails to reduce risk.
proposals.name: multi_touch_low_vol_min

proposals.hypothesis: Multiple pullback sequences combined with extended pullback duration capture a volatile, choppy consolidation pattern. Stocks making repeated recovery attempts over prolonged periods have tight, nervous stop placements that are prone to cascade when price finally moves. The maximum captures whether either dimension of choppiness dominates. Falsifying observation: if stocks with either high pullback count or long pullback duration produce equivalent (or better) stop-loss capture compared to clean, single-sequence patterns, the choppiness interpretation fails.
proposals.name: choppy_slow_recovery_max

proposals.hypothesis: Low relative volume combined with proximity to 52-week high captures institutional absorption near the peak. When both conditions hold simultaneously (low volume percentile AND low distance-to-high percentile), distribution pressure is minimal, reducing cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if low volume far from the 52-week high produces equivalent stop-risk profiles, the institutional-support mechanism fails.
proposals.name: low_vol_near_52w_high_min

proposals.hypothesis: The product of volume ratio percentile and distance-to-52w-high percentile captures the joint probability of volume expansion AND price vulnerability. Stocks near their highs with expanding volume face maximum cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if isolated high volume near the peak or distant stocks with high volume produce equal stop-risk disadvantages, the joint mechanism is spurious.
proposals.name: vol_x_dist_to_high_product

proposals.hypothesis: Deep bases (accumulation) near the 52-week high signal institutional accumulation without distribution, creating a structural floor that limits stop-loss cascades. The minimum captures the binding constraint—either deep accumulation OR near-peak positioning constrains cascade risk. Falsifying observation: if deep bases far from the peak or shallow bases near the peak produce equivalent stop risk, the accumulation-at-high mechanism fails.
proposals.name: deep_base_near_peak_min

proposals.hypothesis: Volatility amplification: when above-median volume coincides with deeper pullbacks, the base structure signals weaker footing. High vol × deep pullback implies institutional distribution risk. Falsified if shallow pullbacks with low volume still produce elevated stop-loss frequency.
proposals.name: vol_pullback_amplification

proposals.hypothesis: Fundamental lag: deep bases paired with weak/negative EPS growth suggest the stock outran fundamentals. This structural deficit raises stop-risk. Falsified if weak EPS combined with shallow bases shows no elevated stop-loss.
proposals.name: deep_base_weak_eps

proposals.hypothesis: Recovery ceiling: both fields are negative when off-peak. Taking the maximum captures the less-damaged state—closer to 52w high or less pullback off peak signals better footing. Falsified if extreme proximity to 52w high with large off-peak pullback shows no stop-risk difference.
proposals.name: off_peak_ceiling_composite

proposals.hypothesis: Multi-base dry pullback: stocks with multiple prior bases that show dry-volume pullbacks signal institutional abandonment. Repeated base formation with volume-starved corrections indicates weakening footprint. Falsified if multi-base stocks with normal pullback volume show equivalent stop-loss frequency.
proposals.name: multi_base_dry_pullback_composite

proposals.hypothesis: Structural overhead burden: deep bases combined with large distance above ceiling capture setups where price must traverse significant resistance. The base structure itself is penalized when overhead supply is heavy. Falsified if stocks with shallow bases and equal ceiling distance show no stop-risk gradient.
proposals.name: deep_base_overhead_burden

proposals.hypothesis: Extended base with weak volume: unusually long consolidation paired with below-median current volume suggests lack of institutional interest sustaining the setup. Duration alone is noisy; volume confirmation filters for genuine accumulation failure. Falsified if long-duration bases with above-median volume show equal or greater stop-loss risk.
proposals.name: extended_base_weak_volume

proposals.hypothesis: Ceiling proximity amplified by elevated volume signals institutional supply at resistance. When stocks are near overhead with above-median current volume, the probability of stopping out increases. Falsified if stocks at equal ceiling distance with low volume show equivalent stop-loss rates.
proposals.name: ceiling_pressure_volume_composite

proposals.hypothesis: Repeated EMA contact combined with volume-starved pullbacks indicates accumulation failure. Each touch without follow-through weakens the support layer, and dry pullbacks confirm institutional absence. Falsified if stocks with equal EMA touches and normal pullback volume show no elevated stop-risk.
proposals.name: ema_touch_dry_pullback_composite

proposals.hypothesis: Multi-base formations with deteriorating volume signal pattern exhaustion. Each additional base increases structural fragility; weak volume confirms diminishing institutional commitment. Falsified if multi-base stocks maintaining normal volume ratios show equal stop-loss frequency to single-base stocks.
proposals.name: base_count_volume_interaction

proposal.hypothesis: Extended consolidation without institutional participation: unusually long bases with below-median current volume signal accumulation failure. Duration alone is structurally noisy; current volume confirms whether institutions are actually engaged. Falsified if long-duration bases with above-median volume show equivalent or greater stop-risk.
proposal.name: extended_base_vol_regulation

proposals.hypothesis: Extended consolidation without institutional participation: unusually long bases with below-median current volume signal accumulation failure. Duration alone is structurally noisy; current volume confirms whether institutions are actually engaged. Falsified if long-duration bases with above-median volume show equivalent or greater stop-risk.
proposals.name: extended_base_vol_regulation

proposals.hypothesis: Near-highs multi-breakdown risk: stocks approaching 52-week highs but sporting multiple prior base formations expose the tension between momentum and structural integrity. Repeated base formation near highs signals failed breakouts, elevating stop-risk when structure gives way. Falsified if proximity to 52w high alone, absent structural history, produces equivalent stop-loss frequency.
proposals.name: 52w_proximity_structure_composite

proposals.hypothesis: Pullback with volume confirmation: deep pullbacks paired with above-median current volume differentiate normal corrections from distribution. Volume confirms whether selling is orderly or aggressive. Falsified if deep pullbacks with low volume show equivalent stop-risk to shallow pullbacks with high volume.
proposals.name: pullback_vol_confirmation
